name: Shadowbreak Ravine
summary: Burning Blade cultists and demons gather in Shadowbreak Ravine, southeast of Magram Village.

sections.title: A Hidden Enclave of Fel
sections.body: Among barren mountain ridges southeast of Magram Village, the ravine stays hidden from wandering centaur tribes. Strange oversized mushrooms rise beside grim ritual camps, where cultists work with summoned demons. Dark practitioners call on fel energies and tend heavy ritual chains. Here, the Burning Blade gathers reinforcements and holds a demonic foothold in Desolace.

faq.answer: Shadowbreak Ravine lies in the mountains of southeastern Desolace, just beyond Magram Village. Demons and Burning Blade cultists use it as a concealed camp and staging ground.
Burning Blade cultists share the ravine with demons. They perform dark rituals there and support the Burning Blade's wider offensive across the region.

faq.q: What features can be found inside the ravine?
faq.answer: Dark ritual structures, heavy iron chains, and giant mushrooms fill the fel-tainted camps hidden among the mountain clefts.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can see the Burning Blade's dark arts at work in the ravine's summoning circles and concentrated fel presence.
